author: stoptryharding
title: DragonSense
tagline: Dragon roars and the Greybeards' summons stop being player-only. Your NPCs hear them, react, and remember.
description:
### Your followers hear the world, not just you

Skyrim's loudest moments are usually yours alone. You hear the roar; the guards beside you carry on sweeping. DragonSense gives the people around you ears for the moments that matter — the ones that happen once and never again.

**A dragon's roar.** Fight one, or hear one across the valley while you walk a road. NPCs near you notice it — sometimes reacting on the spot, sometimes simply remembering it later.

**The Greybeards' summons.** When the shout rolls down from the mountain after the dragon at the Western Watchtower, the people standing beside you hear it too.

**Smaller moments.** Bats bursting from a barrow's dark, old stone grinding in Ustengrav's tomb, and more to come: the set pieces nobody writes a trigger for because they happen once a playthrough.

Near roars and far ones read differently, so a dragon circling above you doesn't sound like one lost somewhere in the fog.

No new quests, no items, nothing added to your load order but the mod itself. It just gives the world ears.
